verdict.rationale: SerpApi is a data/API service (not itself an agent), so this axis applies, and there is direct evidence of an official MCP server repo (serpapi-mcp) for connecting agents. However, the pack lacks deeper documentation (setup instructions, tool list, maintenance status, independent hands-on confirmation) beyond the single repo pointer. Missing for 10: detailed docs/README content on the MCP server's tools and usage, independent/community corroboration that it works as claimed.
